questions: requests r52: "While an answer or a turn the asker has sent has not been taken in by the upstream, `work show <request>` shall print the request on either side as awaiting the upstream and not yet taken in." Reading 1: an answer sent alone, with the turn still the asker's, is enough, so show prints awaiting the upstream even in the asker's turn (clashes with r51). Reading 2: only a sent turn (with any answers sent with it) makes the request await the upstream; an answer sent alone leaves show printing the asker's turn under r51. Also: is 'awaiting the upstream' the status awaiting-upstream or only a description of who acts next?
